name: Joint Base Andrews
description: Home of Air Force One (89th Airlift Wing), the 316th Wing, and the National Capital Region's premier aerial port. Located 10 miles from Washington D.C.

currentNotifications.title: Security Posture — NCR
currentNotifications.body: JBA operates under elevated security awareness due to proximity to Washington D.C. Expect thorough ID and vehicle checks at all gates.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage/birth certificates, and all travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit and complete MPF in-processing. JBA supports both Air Force and joint-service personnel — confirm reporting procedures with your unit.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Housing at 301-981-5670 before arrival. Privatized housing (Corvias) for families. Temporary lodging: Presidential Inn 301-981-4614. High demand — book early.

sections.title: NCR / Washington D.C. Area
sections.body: JBA is 10 miles from Capitol Hill. Metro access via Green Line. Traffic on Auth Rd and Branch Ave can be heavy 0700-0900 and 1600-1800. Many DoD agencies in the region require JBA or Pentagon badge access.
